verdict.rationale: Pipedream exposes machine-readable documentation surfaces (llms.txt, per-app .md endpoint docs, and MCP's dynamic tool-schema listing via mcpClient.tools()) that function as an 'equivalent' machine-readable spec for AI consumption, but there is no explicit OpenAPI spec file or dedicated spec-download endpoint documented. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/JSON schema document users can download, explicit spec versioning, and independent confirmation the .md/llms.txt files are treated as a formal API spec rather than docs.
